decisions.reason: Using an email invitation to add boards to the client's JLCPCB account does not change component-selection, availability, or Extended-part fee policies.
The account setup method does not alter the required BOM contents or their correctness.
Adding boards to a manufacturing account does not change KiCad project portability.
The invitation-based ordering setup does not change which sensor-board production files must be generated.
The manufacturing-account setup method does not affect the ESP32 module or breakout requirements.
The ordering-account workflow does not change the AXP2101 power-path topology.
Adding the boards to the client's account does not alter interboard connectors, pinouts, or power distribution.
The account invitation and ordering method are unrelated to panel input wiring and mounting.
The source decision does not change the LED board's role, LED count, or selected LED part.
The manufacturer-account setup workflow does not alter the main board's dimensions, placement, or connector-layout constraints.
The ordering method does not change the monitored rails, monitoring IC, or measurement coverage.
The JLCPCB account invitation does not affect battery connector placement, orientation, clearance, or spacing.
